title: Grand Theft Auto VI — PlayStation 5 trophies (55)

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so it arrives only when every other trophy in the list has been earned. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap rather than a separate task: work through the story, strangers, activities and 100% stages in order and check your progress here as you go. It cannot be missed on its own, but any missed trophy below it will hold it back. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the mission named Gone Fishing. Play the opening story missions in order and finish this one when it is offered; story missions of this kind normally unlock as part of normal progress. Because it is a named story mission, it should not be missable if you keep following the main story. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 1 so the chapter itself completes. If progress stalls, check your mission list for the next story objective rather than wandering, since chapter trophies usually need the full sequence. Chapter completion is on the main path, so it should not be missable. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing its story missions in order. Keep a separate save before major story beats if the game allows it, which helps if you later want to revisit a choice. As a chapter trophy on the main path, it should unlock through normal story progress and is not treated as missable here. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing through its required story missions. The trophy itself sits on the main story path and should not be missable. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before pushing into the endgame, save separately and finish open stranger strands, because late-story lockouts are the most common way side trophies become hard to recover. The chapter trophy itself should unlock through normal progress. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.

The trophy is unmissable if you finish the story, but finishing early can make some side content harder to return to, so clear flagged missables first. Sources: name, description and grade as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; the approach above is my own advice from the official description and is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
